chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ali ibn Hadid from Jamil ibn Darraj from some of his companions from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them):
Regarding a man who had a female slave, then had intercourse with her, and then bought her mother or her daughter, he said: 'It is not permissible for him.'

key_terms.لاَ تَحِلُّ لَهُ: it is not permissible for him

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to marry the mother or daughter of his own female slave after having intercourse with her?
ai.summary: This hadith from the *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the prohibition of *Mahramiyyah* (consanguinity/marriageability) extending to the mother and daughter of a female slave (*Umm Walad* or *Jariyah*) once the master has consummated relations with her. It illustrates the Shia juristic principle that the act of *Ibtisaj* (consummation) with a slave creates a permanent marital barrier similar to that of free women, preventing the master from marrying her direct female ancestors or descendants.
